pricing.faqChangePlansAnswer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade anytime. When upgrading, you'll be charged the prorated difference. When downgrading, the new rate applies at the next billing cycle.
pricing.faqSubmissionLimit: What happens if I hit my submission limit?
pricing.faqSubmissionLimitAnswer: You'll receive a notification at 80% and 100% usage. Once you hit the limit, new submissions are queued until the next billing cycle — no data is lost. You can upgrade anytime to unlock more.

pricing.faqCancelAnswer: You can cancel anytime from your workspace settings. Your data is retained for 30 days after cancellation, and you can export everything before then.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introBody: FormForge ("we", "our", "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our platform at formforge.app (the "Service").
privacy.workspaceDataForms: Forms, form fields, and form settings
privacy.dataStorageIntro: Your data is stored securely using the following services:
privacy.storageSupabase: Supabase (PostgreSQL database): All application data including profiles, forms, submissions, and workspace data. Data is encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.2+). Hosted on AWS in the US region.
privacy.storageAuth: Supabase Auth: Authentication tokens and session management.
privacy.storageVercel: Vercel: Frontend hosting and CDN delivery. No user data stored on Vercel servers.
privacy.dataProcessingIntro: We use the following third-party services that may process your data:
privacy.processingStripe: Stripe: Payment processing for subscriptions. We do not store credit card details. Stripe's privacy policy applies to payment data.
privacy.processingResend: Resend: Transactional email delivery (waitlist invitations, ticket notifications). Email addresses and message content are processed by Resend.
privacy.processingAi: Anthropic (Claude AI): AI-powered features (form generation, ticket classification). Form content may be sent to Anthropic's API for processing. Anthropic does not use this data for training.
privacy.dataSharingIntro: We do not sell your personal data. We share data only with:
privacy.sharingProviders: Third-party service providers listed above (for service operation)
privacy.sharingMembers: Workspace members (within the same workspace, as configured by the workspace owner)
privacy.dataRetentionIntro: We retain your data for as long as your account is active. When you delete your account:
privacy.retentionProfile: All profile data is permanently deleted
privacy.retentionWorkspaces: All workspaces you own (and their forms, submissions, etc.) are permanently deleted
privacy.retentionBackup: Backup data is purged within 30 days of deletion
privacy.yourRightsIntro: Under GDPR and applicable data protection laws, you have the right to:
privacy.rightAccess: Access: View all data we hold about you (available in Settings > Data Export)
privacy.rightExport: Export: Download your data in JSON format (available in Settings > Data Export)
privacy.rightDeletion: Deletion: Delete your account and all associated data (available in Settings > Delete Account)
privacy.rightRectification: Rectification: Update or correct your personal data (available in Settings > Profile)
privacy.rightRestriction: Restriction: Request we limit processing of your data
privacy.rightPortability: Portability: Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format
privacy.cookiesNoTracking: We do not use tracking cookies. No third-party advertising cookies are set.
privacy.securityIntro: We implement the following security measures:
privacy.securityRls: Row-Level Security (RLS) on all database tables
privacy.securityJwt: JWT-based authentication with automatic token refresh
privacy.contactIntro: For privacy-related inquiries, data requests, or concerns, contact us at:
privacy.changesBody: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify users of material changes via email or an in-app notification. Continued use of the Service after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
